<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4466.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2970><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>PART I</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2971><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2972><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Item&nbsp;1.&nbsp;&nbsp;Business</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2973><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2974><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Company Overview</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2975><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2976><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Peerless Systems Corporation (referred to herein as &#8220;Peerless,&#8221; the &#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; or &#8220;us&#8221;) licenses imaging and networking technologies to the digital document markets, which include original equipment manufacturers (&#8220;OEMs&#8221;) of color and monochrome printers and multifunction office products.&nbsp;&nbsp;We license software-based imaging and networking technology for controllers in embedded, attached and stand-alone digital document products such as printers, copiers and multifunction products (&#8220;MFPs&#8221;) of OEMs. We were incorporated in California in 1982 and reincorporated in Delaware in September&nbsp;1996.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2977><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2978><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Historically, we developed controller products and applications for sale to OEMs.&nbsp;&nbsp;In order to process digital text and graphics, digital document products rely on a core set of imaging software and supporting electronics, collectively known as a digital imaging system.&nbsp;&nbsp;Digital document products include monochrome (black and white) and color printers, copiers, fax machines and scanners, as well as MFPs that perform a combination of these imaging functions.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our historical business has consisted of (i) products with Peerless developed intellectual property, (ii) products based upon an agreement with Novell Inc. (&#8220;Novell&#8221;) to license and support the Novell Embedded Systems Technology (&#8220;NEST&#8221;) Office Software Developers Kit (&#8220;SDK&#8221;), (iii) products based upon an agreement with Adobe Systems Incorporated (&#8220;Adobe&#8221;) to bundle and sublicense Adobe&#8217;s licensed products into products for OEMs, and (iv) products based upon agreements with various other third parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our contract with Adobe expired on March 31, 2010, but we continue to license our software for Adobe existing licensed devices (&#8220;AELD&#8221;) developed prior to such date.&nbsp; See Item 1A.&nbsp;Risk Factors - Risks Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business -<I> We expect a continued decrease in our Adobe Related revenues for fiscal 2015 due to the expiration of our agreement with Adobe</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2979><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2980><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Effective April 30, 2008, we sold certain of our assets to Kyocera-Mita Corporation (&#8220;KMC&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;In this transaction (the &#8220;KMC Transaction&#8221;), we retained certain intellectual property and also entered into a license agreement with KMC whereby we have the right to sublicense to third parties the technology we sold to KMC.&nbsp;&nbsp;Following the completion of the KMC Transaction, we continue to license and market our remaining technology and the technology licensed back to us by KMC, directly to OEM customers including Oki Data, Seiko Epson and Xerox International Partners (&#8220;XIP&#8221;).&nbsp;&nbsp;We also sublicense to KMC the right to use certain technologies excluded from the KMC Transaction. Our embedded application solution offerings also incorporate imaging and networking technologies developed internally or licensed from third parties.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2981><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2982><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Following the closing of the KMC Transaction, we have focused on managing costs and aligning expenses to better match anticipated revenue.&nbsp;&nbsp;We are also exploring various alternatives to enhance stockholder value through establishing&nbsp;a new venture or&nbsp;acquiring an existing business, as well as through other investment opportunities.&nbsp;&nbsp;See &#8220;Strategic Alternatives&#8221; and &#8220;Interim Investment Activities&#8221; under &#8220;Strategy for&nbsp;Our Company&#8221; below.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2983><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2984><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In December 2010, the Company opened an office in Stamford, Connecticut, which became the Company&#8217;s headquarters on February 1, 2011.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company closed its office in El Segundo, California on January 31, 2012 and now operates exclusively at its Stamford, Connecticut office.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2985><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2986><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Services Provided</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2987><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2988><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Following the KMC Transaction, our primary business is licensing software-based imaging and networking systems for the digital document product marketplace.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2989><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2990><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our legacy business has consisted of (i) products with Peerless developed intellectual property, (ii) products based upon our agreement with Novell&nbsp;to sublicense and support NEST Office SDK, (iii) products based upon an agreement with Adobe to bundle and sublicense Adobe&#8217;s licensed products into products for OEMs and (iv) products based upon agreements with various other third parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our agreement with Adobe expired on March 31, 2010. Subsequent to March 31, 2010, we are no longer able to license new devices with respect to our Adobe line of business.&nbsp;&nbsp;We will continue to collect licensing fees from our customers for AELD under our current sublicensing agreements.&nbsp;&nbsp;All maintenance revenue generated from our products ended on July 31, 2010.&nbsp;&nbsp;We continue to be party to a license agreement with Novell and&nbsp;we expect to continue to collect licensing fees for the useful life of the Novell related technology.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2991><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4467.1><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<DIV style="WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" id=PGBK4467 >
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGFTR4467 >&nbsp;</DIV>
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" id=PGNUM4467 >1</DIV>
<HR style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%; HEIGHT: 2px; COLOR: #000000" noShade>

<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGHDR4467 >&nbsp;</DIV></DIV>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4467.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2992><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Customers</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2993><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2994><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We currently derive substantially all of our revenues from direct sales to digital document product OEMs.&nbsp;&nbsp; In addition to our own technology retained in the KMC Transaction, we license technology based in whole or in part on licenses from KMC and other third parties, including Novell and Adobe. Our license agreement with Adobe, which expired on March 31, 2010, generated substantial revenues for us prior to its expiration.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Adobe agreement will only continue to generate revenue through the commercial life of AELD.&nbsp;&nbsp;See Item&nbsp;1A. Risk Factors &#8211; Risks Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business -<I> We expect a continued decrease in our Adobe related revenues for fiscal 2015 due to the expiration of our agreement with Adobe</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2995><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2996><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We anticipate that our future revenues may continue to be concentrated with a limited number of customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our largest customers (each constituting approximately 10% or more of our total revenues) vary to some extent from year to year as product cycles end, block licenses are exhausted and contractual relationships expire.&nbsp; We had three such large customers in fiscal year 2014 - Novell, KMC, and Oki Data. In the aggregate, these three customers accounted for 93% of our total revenues for fiscal year 2014.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2997><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2998><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our licensing revenue is calculated based on the number of products that include our technology shipped by our customers and as such, the life cycles of these products significantly impact our revenue.&nbsp;&nbsp;Because we generate a large percentage of our revenues from a small number of customers and a limited number of products, any loss of these customers or products would have a material adverse impact on the results of our operations.&nbsp;&nbsp;See Item 1A. Risk Factors &#8211; Risk Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business &#8211;<I> There is currently limited demand for our products, and we expect demand will continue to decline in the future.</I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA2999><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3000><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Market Segments and Geographic Areas</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3001><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3002><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We sell our products to OEMs which manufacture products for the enterprise and office sector of the digital document product market.&nbsp;&nbsp;This market is characterized by digital document products ranging in price from approximately $500 to $1,000 each at the low end, to more than $50,000 at the high end.&nbsp;&nbsp;These products typically offer high performance and are differentiated by customized features.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of these unique requirements, we have typically addressed the office sector of the digital document product market via direct OEM relationships with individual digital document product manufacturers.&nbsp;&nbsp;Over the last two fiscal years, our major customers in the office sector have included Novell, KMC and Oki Data</FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3003><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3004><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Since most of our OEM customers are headquartered in Japan, traditionally the majority of our revenues were generated from outside the United States. Our OEM customers headquartered in Japan sell their products containing our technology primarily in the North American, Japanese and European marketplaces.&nbsp;&nbsp;However, this tradition was reversed in fiscal year 2013 and 2012, and a majority of our revenues came from customers headquartered in the United States.&nbsp; This shift was due to our Japan-headquartered OEM customers not renewing block licenses which had been recognized in previous quarters and shipments from customers within the United States declining at a slower rate than shipments from customers outside of the United States.&nbsp;&nbsp; Now that all of our Japan-headquartered customers have fully utilized their existing block licenses, they are now currently paying us on a pay-as-you-go basis. Our Japanese OEM customers contributed 61% of our total revenues in fiscal year 2014.&nbsp; </FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3005><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp; &nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3006><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">All of our contracts with international customers are denominated in U.S. dollars, and we expect this practice to continue.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, we do not incur material foreign currency risks or costs in our business.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3007><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3008><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Industry Overview</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3009><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3010><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The document imaging industry has rapidly changed.&nbsp;&nbsp;Historically, most electronic imaging products in the office environment were stand-alone, monochrome machines, which were dedicated to a single print, copy, fax or scan function.&nbsp;&nbsp;Today&#8217;s imaging products combine printer, fax and scan functions in a single, color MFP or All-in-One (&#8220;AiO&#8221;) device.&nbsp;&nbsp;These changes in technology and end-user requirements have created challenges for digital document product manufacturers.&nbsp;&nbsp;These challenges include customer expectations for higher performance products at lower prices as well as the desire and ability of product manufacturers to develop more and more technology in-house.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3011><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3012><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Technology</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3013><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3014><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I>Digital Imaging Products.&nbsp;&nbsp;</I>Peerless licenses software-based embedded imaging components to OEMs of printers and MFPs.&nbsp;&nbsp;These imaging components increase the performance, image quality and network connectivity of such devices while lowering the overall device cost.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our offerings to our customers have included the following products, most of which we sold to KMC and licensed back from KMC in the KMC Transaction:</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3015><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4468.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 36pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3045><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;Our agreements with both third party licensors and our customers have allowed us to integrate the proprietary technologies we originally developed, most of which we sold to KMC and licensed back as part of the KMC Transaction, and to license complementary technologies from such third party licensors to our customers in bundled or single sales.&nbsp;&nbsp;We are party to a license agreement with Novell&nbsp;to license the NEST Office SDK.&nbsp;&nbsp;From 1999 to March 2010, we were party to a license agreement with Adobe to license Adobe PostScript. Our agreement with Adobe expired on March 31, 2010.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3046><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3047><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Strategy for Our Company</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3048><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3049><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Following the closing of the KMC Transaction, we have focused on managing costs and aligning expenses to better match anticipated revenue.&nbsp;&nbsp;We are exploring various alternatives to enhance stockholder value through establishing&nbsp;a new venture or&nbsp;acquiring an existing business, as well as through other investment opportunities.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3050><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3051><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>Historical Business.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3052><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3053><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Since 2008, we have implemented a strategy for our historical business to address declining demand for our core imaging technologies from our traditional OEM customer base.&nbsp;&nbsp;The strategy involves maximizing the value of core technologies and managing costs and aligning expenses to better match revenue forecast.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3054><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3055><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I>Managing Expenses.</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>&nbsp;&nbsp;</B></I> On an ongoing basis, we will continue to manage our business in a manner that aligns our operating expenses with our anticipated revenue streams.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3056><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3057><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I>Core Technologies.</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>&nbsp;&nbsp;</B></I>&nbsp;We will continue to license technology that we own or to which we have licensing rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;Although our license agreement with Adobe has expired, we will continue to collect license fees from our current OEM customers for the commercial life of all AELD under our current sublicense agreements.&nbsp;&nbsp;We will continue to license our products with Peerless developed intellectual property, our Novell related products and other products which we own or to which we have licensing rights to current OEM customers.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3058><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3059><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>Strategic Alternatives.&nbsp;&nbsp;</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3060><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3061><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Since the sale of substantially all of our assets in the KMC Transaction, we have been identifying and exploring various alternatives to enhance stockholder value.&nbsp;&nbsp;In fiscal 2015, our strategy may include establishing a new venture that utilizes the expertise of management and the Board of Directors, as well as identifying acquisition candidates and investment opportunities.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3062><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3063><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our inability to implement our strategic plan to develop a new business or acquire or invest in another company, as well as the declining sales trend of our historical business, may have a material adverse effect on our business and financial results.&nbsp;&nbsp;See Item&nbsp;1A. Risk Factors &#8211; Risks Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business -<I><B> </B></I><I>There is currently limited demand for our products and we expect demand will continue to decline in the future</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3064><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3065><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>Interim Investment Activities</B></I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3066><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3067><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Until we establish a new venture, acquire an existing business or make some other long-term investment, the objective of our interim investment activities is to maintain liquidity and prudently grow the Company&#8217;s available capital by investing in a&nbsp;mix of short-term money market funds, exchange-traded equity securities and other marketable securities, but only to the extent that such investments do not&nbsp;inadvertently make the Company subject to the Investment Company Act of 1940.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3068><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3069><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">During fiscal year 2012, we took advantage of an increase in volatility in the markets by investing some of our cash into marketable securities.&nbsp;&nbsp;We recorded approximately $1.8 million of realized gains on investments during the fiscal year ended January 31, 2012. During fiscal year 2013, we significantly scaled back our investing activities and had a net realized gain of approximately $0.1 million. During fiscal year 2014, our attempt to improve our returns by trying to take advantage of the market volatility on our capital was unsuccessful and we suffered a loss of approximately $1.5 million. We also realized a loss in our investment in ModusLink Global Solutions, Inc. of $0.7 million in fiscal year 2014. The cumulative result over the life of our investment in ModusLink was a loss of $34,000.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3070><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3071><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We are exposed to a variety of risks in investments, including the stability of the financial institutions in which we maintain our investments and a decline in interest rates.&nbsp; See Item 1A. Risk Factors &#8211; Risk Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business &#8211;<I> The failure of any financial institution in which we deposit funds could significantly reduce the amount of cash we have available&nbsp;for our corporate and business purposes</I> and risks under Item 1A. Risk Factors &#8211; Risks Related to Our Strategy to Increase Value for Stockholders.</FONT></P>

<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4469.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3073><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Intellectual Property and Proprietary Rights</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3074><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3075><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We protect our proprietary rights through a combination of, among other things, trade secret, copyright and trademark laws, as well as the early implementation of nondisclosure and other contractual restrictions.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3076><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3077><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In the KMC Transaction, we sold substantially all of our intellectual property (&#8220;IP&#8221;), including all of our patents, to KMC and licensed this IP back from KMC on a nonexclusive, worldwide, perpetual and royalty free basis, subject to certain restrictions.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the KMC Transaction, we retained certain of our customized intellectual property that had been previously integrated into products we licensed to third parties or specifically created for our customers (other than KMC) after December&nbsp;7, 2007.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3078><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3079><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As part of our confidentiality procedures, we enter into written nondisclosure agreements with our employees, consultants, prospective customers, OEMs and strategic partners and take further affirmative steps to limit access to and distribution of our software, intellectual property and other proprietary information.&nbsp;&nbsp;Despite these efforts and in the event such agreements are not timely made, complied with or enforced, we may be unable to protect our proprietary rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;See Item&nbsp;1A. Risk Factors - Risks Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business</FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>&nbsp;</B></I><B> &#8211;</B></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;<I> If we fail to adequately protect intellectual property or face a claim of intellectual property infringement by a third party, we could lose our intellectual property rights or be liable for damages</I></FONT><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3080><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3081><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;<B>Competition</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3082><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3083><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">The market for outsourced imaging systems for digital document products is highly competitive and characterized by continuous pressure to enhance performance, add functionality, reduce costs and accelerate the release of new products.&nbsp;&nbsp;We compete on the basis of the set of core technologies we sublicense from third parties, technology expertise, product functionality and price.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our technology primarily competes with solutions developed internally by OEMs.&nbsp;&nbsp;Virtually all of our OEM customers have made significant investments in their existing solutions and have substantial resources to enhance existing products and to develop future products.&nbsp;&nbsp;These OEMs have developed, are developing or may develop competing imaging system technologies and may implement these systems into their products, thereby replacing our technologies and further limiting our future business opportunities.&nbsp;&nbsp; OEMs have increasingly been shifting away from third party solutions in favor of in-house development.&nbsp;&nbsp;Therefore, we face competition from products internally developed by OEMs.&nbsp;&nbsp;Although we continue to license and market the technology which we own or to which we have licensing rights directly to OEM customers, we have experienced increased difficulty in these efforts.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3084><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3085><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our opportunities have been limited since the completion of the KMC Transaction and have become further limited because our license agreement with Adobe, pursuant to which we bundled and sublicensed Adobe&#8217;s licensed products into new products for OEMs, expired on March 31, 2010.&nbsp;&nbsp;We compete in the digital document product marketplace.&nbsp;&nbsp; Our competitors include Electronics for Imaging Inc., Primax Electronics, Ltd. (formerly known as Destiny Technology Corporation), Global Graphics Software Ltd., SOFHA GmbH, Software Imaging, Ltd. and CSR (formerly Zoran Corporation).&nbsp;&nbsp;Our networking and security products compete with, among others, Silex Technology Inc, SafeNet Inc. and RSA, a division of EMC Corporation.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3086><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3087><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Employees</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3088><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3089><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As of January&nbsp;31, 2014, we had two full-time employees.&nbsp;&nbsp;None of our employees are represented by a labor union, and we have never experienced any work stoppage.&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3090><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3091><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Available Information</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3092><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3093><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our website address is www.peerless.com.&nbsp;&nbsp;We make available, free of charge through our website, our Annual Reports on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, Current Reports on Form 8-K, Proxy Statements and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act as soon as reasonably practicable after such material is electronically filed with or furnished to the SEC.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3094><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3095><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our filings may also be read and copied at the SEC&#8217;s Public Reference Room at 100 F Street NE, Room&nbsp;1580 Washington, DC 20549.&nbsp;&nbsp;Information on the operation of the Public Reference Room may be obtained by calling the SEC at 1-800-SEC-0330.&nbsp;&nbsp;The SEC also maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC.&nbsp;&nbsp;The address of that website is www.sec.gov.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3096><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3097><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Item&nbsp;1A.&nbsp;&nbsp;Risk Factors</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3098><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3099><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our short and long term success is subject to many factors that are beyond our control.&nbsp;&nbsp;Stockholders and prospective stockholders in the Company should consider carefully the following risk factors, in addition to the information contained in this report.&nbsp;&nbsp;This Annual Report on Form 10-K contains &#8220;forward-looking statements,&#8221; within the meaning of Section&nbsp;27A of the Securities Act and Section&nbsp;21 of the Exchange Act, which are subject to a variety of risks and uncertainties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our actual results could differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth below.&nbsp;See &#8220;Forward Looking Statements&#8221; above.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3100><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4470.1><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<DIV style="WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" id=PGBK4470 >
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGFTR4470 >&nbsp;</DIV>
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" id=PGNUM4470 >4</DIV>

<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGHDR4470 >&nbsp;</DIV></DIV>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4470.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3101><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><B>Risks Related to Our Company and Our Historical Business</B></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3102><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3103><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>We expect a continued decrease in our Adobe related revenues for fiscal 2015 due to the expiration of our agreement with Adobe.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3104><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3105><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our agreement with Adobe to bundle and sublicense Adobe&#8217;s licensed products into new OEM products expired on March 31, 2010.&nbsp; We are unable to transition our customer base to another provider.&nbsp;&nbsp;We will only continue to collect licensing fees for the commercial life of all AELD for the useful life of these products under existing sublicensing agreements.&nbsp;&nbsp;We expect a decrease in our Adobe related revenues for fiscal 2015 due to the expiration of this agreement.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our revenues from licensing products that include Adobe technology were approximately $0.8 million and $0.7 million for fiscal 2014 and 2013, respectively.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 33pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3106><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3107><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>There is currently limited demand for our products and we expect demand will continue to decline in the future.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3108><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3109><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Since the completion of the KMC Transaction, we have continued to license and market the technology which we own or to which we have licensing rights directly to OEM customers.&nbsp; Our licensing arrangements with our customers are based on the number of products including our technology shipped by these customers and the life cycles of these products.&nbsp;&nbsp;Because we generate a large percentage of our revenues from a small number of customers and a few products, any loss of these customers or products would have a material adverse impact on our results of operations.&nbsp;&nbsp;There has been a general decline in the rates of growth for the monochrome work group printer and MFP market segments in which we are engaged.&nbsp;&nbsp;For those product platforms that do utilize the software we license, the competition has increased and we have experienced significant downward price pressure.&nbsp;&nbsp;Although our technology can be modified to meet the needs of our customers, since 2007, we have elected not to develop new products and, since late 2010, we have elected not to maintain a development engineering staff.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of this, OEM demand for our solutions has declined.&nbsp;&nbsp;This decline occurred in some cases because the OEMs perceived that our solutions did not meet their technical requirements.&nbsp;&nbsp;In other cases it occurred because the OEMs either developed the technology themselves or utilized lower cost offshore software competitors. Although we continue to license our current technology and products to certain OEMs, there can be no assurance that the OEMs will continue to need or utilize the products and technology we currently offer.&nbsp;&nbsp;We had an agreement with Adobe to bundle and sublicense Adobe&#8217;s licensed products into new OEM products which expired on March 31, 2010.&nbsp;&nbsp;This termination has substantially reduced the range of products we are able to offer.&nbsp;&nbsp;We believe this will materially diminish our ability to continue licensing products in the future.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3110><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3111><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>We receive a substantial portion of our revenues from a limited number of customers and any adverse change in our relationships with those customers will materially harm our business.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3112><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3113><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">A limited number of OEM customers continue to provide a substantial portion of our revenues.&nbsp;&nbsp;Presently, there are only a small number of OEM customers in the digital document product market to which we can market our technology and services. Therefore, our ability to offset a significant decrease in the revenues from a particular customer or to replace a lost customer is severely limited.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3114><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 45pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3115><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Customers that individually represented approximately 10% or more of our total revenues collectively accounted for 93% and 89% of our revenues for fiscal 2014 and fiscal 2013, respectively. Each of Novell, KMC, Oki Data and XIP constituted customers representing approximately10% or more of our total revenues in fiscal 2014 and/or fiscal 2013.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3116><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3117><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Along with our OEM customers and third party technology suppliers, we face intense competition within our industry, which is applying significant downward pricing pressure on products.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, our OEM customers and third party technology suppliers continue to seek lower cost alternatives.&nbsp;&nbsp;Some of our OEM customers and third party technology suppliers, including Adobe, have developed extensive offshore operations in countries such as India that are capable of delivering lower cost solutions. The ability of our OEM customers and third party technology suppliers to provide similar offerings at a lower cost may result in them no longer needing our services, as well as being in direct competition with us by providing similar technologies at a lower cost to our other customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;This may result in us losing some of our customers and may have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and future cash flows.&nbsp;&nbsp;See &#8220;Financial Statements &#8211; Note 12 Risks and Uncertainties.&#8221;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3118><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3119><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;<I><B>Our licensing revenue is subject to significant fluctuations which may materially and adversely affect our operating results.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3120><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3121><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Our recurring license agreements may result in revenues associated with the sale of block and perpetual licenses.&nbsp;&nbsp;Block and perpetual licenses can create significant fluctuations in revenues as they are most often recognized as revenue immediately instead of over time. While we expect most of our customers to shift from block license or prepay model to a pay-as-you-go model, we may still sell block and perpetual licenses. Revenues may continue to fluctuate significantly from quarter to quarter as the number of opportunities vary, if the signing of block licenses are delayed or the licensing opportunities are lost to competitors.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, we may experience additional significant fluctuation as aging OEM products leave the marketplace. Any of these factors could have a material adverse effect on our operating results.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3122><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4471.1><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<DIV style="WIDTH: 100%; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" id=PGBK4471 >
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGFTR4471 >&nbsp;</DIV>
<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: center; WIDTH: 100%; FONT-SIZE: 10pt" id=PGNUM4471 >5</DIV>
<HR style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%; HEIGHT: 2px; COLOR: #000000" noShade>

<DIV style="TEXT-ALIGN: left; WIDTH: 100%" id=PGHDR4471 >&nbsp;</DIV></DIV>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4471.2><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3123><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>The industry for imaging systems for digital document products involves intense competition and rapid technological changes, and our business will likely be materially harmed when our competitors develop superior technology.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3124><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3125><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We anticipate increasing competition for our color products, particularly as new competitors develop and sell competing products.&nbsp;&nbsp;Some of our existing competitors, many of our potential competitors, and virtually all of our OEM customers have substantially greater financial, technical, marketing and sales resources than we have.&nbsp;&nbsp;Furthermore, we are not investing in technology to update our products.&nbsp;&nbsp;Other competitors are likely to develop new products which replace the products we currently offer.&nbsp;&nbsp;If price competition increases, competitive pressures could require us to reduce the amount of royalties received on new licenses.&nbsp;&nbsp;New technology developed by our competitors will further erode our market share and reduce our royalty revenue.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3126><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3127><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>If we fail to adequately protect intellectual property or face a claim of intellectual property infringement by a third party, we could lose our intellectual property rights or be liable for damages.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3128><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3129><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We protect our proprietary rights in a number of ways, including, but not limited to, trade secret, copyright and trademark laws, as well as early implementation of nondisclosure and other contractual restrictions.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3130><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3131><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As part of the KMC Transaction, we sold substantially all of our intellectual property, including all of our patents to KMC and executed a license agreement pursuant to which KMC licensed the intellectual property back to us on a nonexclusive, worldwide, perpetual and royalty free basis subject to certain restrictions.&nbsp;&nbsp;Excluded from the IP that was sold to KMC was all of our customized intellectual property that had been previously integrated into products or services licensed or otherwise provided by us to third parties or specifically created for customers of ours after December&nbsp;7, 2007 other than KMC and, which, in either case, had not also been provided to or integrated into products or services licensed to KMC, or developed pursuant to or in connection with certain agreements with KMC.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3132><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3133><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As part of our confidentiality procedures, we enter into written nondisclosure agreements with our employees, consultants, prospective customers, OEMs and strategic partners and take further affirmative steps to limit access to and distribution of our software, intellectual property and other proprietary information.&nbsp;&nbsp;Despite these efforts and in the event such agreements are not timely made, complied with or enforced, we may be unable to protect our proprietary rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;In any event, enforcement of our proprietary rights may be very expensive.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our source code also is protected as a trade secret.&nbsp;&nbsp;However, from time to time, we license our source code to OEMs pursuant to protective agreements, which subjects us to the risk of unauthorized use or misappropriation despite contractual terms restricting disclosure, distribution, copying and use.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, it may be possible for unauthorized third parties to obtain, distribute, copy or use our proprietary information, or to reverse engineer our trade secrets.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3134><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3135><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">As the number of patents, copyrights, trademarks and other intellectual property rights in our industry increases, products using our technologies increasingly may become the subject of infringement claims.&nbsp;&nbsp;There can be no assurance that third parties will not assert infringement claims against us in the future.&nbsp;&nbsp;Any such claims, regardless of merit, could be time consuming, divert the efforts of our management personnel from productive tasks, result in costly litigation, cause product shipment delays or require us to enter into royalty or licensing agreements.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such royalty or licensing agreements, if required, may not be available on terms acceptable to us, or at all, which could have a material adverse effect on our operating results.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, we may initiate claims or litigation against third parties for infringement of our proprietary rights or to establish the validity of our proprietary rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;Litigation to determine the validity of any claims, whether or not such litigation is determined in favor of us, could result in significant expense to us and divert the efforts of our management personnel from productive tasks.&nbsp;&nbsp;We may lack sufficient resources to initiate a meritorious claim.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event of an adverse ruling in any litigation regarding intellectual property, we may be required to pay substantial damages, discontinue the use and sale of infringing products, expend significant resources to develop non-infringing technology, or obtain licenses to infringing or substituted technology.&nbsp;&nbsp;Our failure to develop or license on acceptable terms a substitute technology, if required, could have a material adverse effect on our operating results.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3136><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3137><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>If we are not in compliance with our license agreements, we may lose our rights to sublicense technology; our competitors are aggressively pursuing the sale of licensed third party technology.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3138><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3139><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We currently sublicense third party technologies to our OEM customers, which sublicenses accounted for $2.3 million and $1.2 million in revenue in fiscal 2014 and 2013, respectively.&nbsp;&nbsp;Such sublicense agreements are non-exclusive.&nbsp;&nbsp;If we are determined not to be in compliance with the agreements between us and our licensors, we may forfeit our right to sublicense these technologies. Likewise, if such sublicense agreements expire, we would lose our right to sublicense the affected technologies, which could adversely affect our revenues.&nbsp;&nbsp;Additionally, the licensing of such technologies has become very competitive, with competitors possessing substantially greater financial and technical resources and market penetration than us.&nbsp;&nbsp;As competitors are pursuing aggressive strategies to obtain similar rights as held by us to sublicense these third party technologies, there is no assurance that we can remain competitive in the marketplace if one or more competitors are successful in this strategy.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3140><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="MARGIN-TOP: 0px; MARGIN-BOTTOM: 0px" id=PARA4472.1><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3141><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>Our international activities may expose us to risks associated with international business.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3142><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3143><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We are substantially dependent on our international business activities.&nbsp;&nbsp;Risks inherent in these international business activities,&nbsp;any of which could have a material adverse effect on our operating results, include:</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3144><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3147><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">changes in the economic, geographic or environmental conditions of foreign countries, including, but not limited to, Japan where many of our customers are located;</FONT></P></TD></TR>

<TD style="WIDTH: 90.2%; VERTICAL-ALIGN: top">
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3150><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P></TD></TR>

<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3185><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3186><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">If we are unable to adapt to international conditions, our business may be adversely affected.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3187><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3188><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>The failure of any financial institution in which we deposit funds could significantly reduce the amount of cash we have available&nbsp;for our corporate and business purposes.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3189><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3190><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">We maintain our cash in various&nbsp;accounts with nationally-recognized financial institutions.&nbsp;&nbsp;Although we have diversified our holdings in multiple institutions, our accounts may be uninsured and therefore subject to loss or total&nbsp;forfeiture.&nbsp;&nbsp;Financial institutions are subject to general credit, liquidity, market and interest rate risks, which have been exacerbated by the recent financial and credit crisis and bankruptcies which have affected various sectors of the financial markets and led to global credit and liquidity issues.&nbsp;&nbsp;If any of the financial institutions in which we have deposited funds ultimately fails or freezes redemptions of our accounts, we may lose part or all of our investments.&nbsp;&nbsp;The loss of part or all of our investments could significantly reduce the amount of cash we have available for our corporate and business purposes, which would materially and adversely affect our operations.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3191><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3192><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>Failure to maintain our Nasdaq listing would adversely affect the trading price and liquidity of our common stock.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3193><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3194><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">If we are not able to maintain compliance with Nasdaq&#8217;s listing requirements, our common stock may be subject to removal from listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market.&nbsp;&nbsp;Trading in our common stock after a delisting, if any, would likely be conducted in the over-the-counter markets in the so-called &#8220;pink sheets&#8221; and could also be subject to additional restrictions.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a consequence of a delisting, our stockholders would find it more difficult to dispose, or obtain accurate quotations as to the market value, of our common stock.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, a delisting would make our common stock substantially less attractive as collateral for margin purpose loans, for investment by financial institutions under their internal policies or state legal investment laws or as consideration in future capital raising transactions.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3195><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3196><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt"><I><B>If we fail to maintain an effective system of internal control over financial reporting or discover material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting or financial reporting practices, we may not be able to report our financial results accurately or detect fraud, which could harm our business and the trading price of our stock.</B></I></FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3197><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; TEXT-INDENT: 44pt; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3198><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">Effective internal controls are necessary for us to produce reliable financial reports and are important in our effort to prevent financial fraud.&nbsp;&nbsp;We are required to periodically evaluate the effectiveness of the design and operation of our internal controls. These evaluations may result in the conclusion that enhancements, modifications or changes to our internal controls are necessary or desirable.&nbsp;&nbsp;While management evaluates the effectiveness of our internal controls on a regular basis, we cannot provide absolute assurance that these controls will always be effective or any assurance that the controls, accounting processes, procedures and underlying assumptions will not be subject to revision.&nbsp;&nbsp;There are also inherent limitations on the effectiveness of internal controls and financial reporting practices, including collusion, management override and failure of human judgment.&nbsp;&nbsp;Because of this, control procedures and financial reporting practices are designed to reduce rather than eliminate business risks.&nbsp;&nbsp;We are required to document and test our internal control procedures under Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, which includes annual management assessments of the effectiveness of such internal controls.&nbsp;&nbsp;If we fail to maintain an effective system of internal control over financial reporting or if management or our independent registered public accounting firm&nbsp;discovered material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting (or if our system of controls and audits results in a change of practices or new information or conclusions about our financial reporting), we may be unable to produce reliable financial reports or prevent fraud and it could harm our financial condition and results of operations and result in loss of investor confidence and a decline in our stock price.</FONT></P>
<P style="TEXT-ALIGN: justify; LINE-HEIGHT: 1.25; MARGIN: 0pt" id=PARA3199><FONT style="FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman, Times, serif; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
